name: REC Alpha Pure-R 400W
notes: Technology: HJT (heterojunction) cells, 80 half-cell, monofacial with single 3.2mm glass, lead-free construction. Runs 400-430W in 10W steps. Pros: HJT's best-in-class temperature coefficient and lowest degradation of any silicon technology, plus a unique 4-section cell layout for shading tolerance; notably high voltage (58.9-59.7V) and low current (under 9A) suit longer strings than a typical panel of this wattage. Cons: the most expensive technology per watt in this database alongside Maxeon's IBC, and monofacial only despite HJT's naturally high bifaciality potential.
